complexity.notes: Slightly unusual formulation (half-open window plus a modular index at the end instead of the more common nums[mid] vs nums[right] test), but the invariant is sound and it handles the zero-rotation case via the modulo wrap.
complexity.summary: Binary search for the rotation descent: maintains a window [start, end) in which the single drop must lie, comparing nums[start] with nums[mid] to decide which half to keep, then returns the element just after the final start index (wrapping for the unrotated case).
